proposed_widenings.name: option_grant family for class features
proposed_widenings.justification: Metamagic does not activate with a cost — it passively grants access to N spell-modifying options chosen from a menu. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family ('activation') requires activationCost + resource (use_count) + resetCadence, none of which apply here. A new family is needed for features that grant permanent access to a set of choice-based modifiers.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you gain two Metamagic options of your choice from 'Metamagic Options' later in this class's description

proposed_widenings.name: point_pool resource (cross-feature shared pool)
proposed_widenings.justification: Sorcery Points are a shared numeric pool defined by Font of Magic and referenced by individual Metamagic options at use time. UseCountResource is per-feature and self-contained (has its own cap + resetCadence). There is no mechanism to reference a cross-feature resource pool that multiple features draw from. Encoding Metamagic's SP cost as a per-feature use_count would be a fabrication.
proposed_widenings.evidence: To use an option, you must spend the number of Sorcery Points that it costs.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_option_set (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect of the Metamagic feature is granting access to N spell-modifying options from a closed menu, with a count that scales by class level. ClassFeatureEffect currently only supports grant_extra_action and heal_hp. A new variant for 'grant access to N chosen modifiers from a menu' is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain two more options at Sorcerer level 10 and two more at Sorcerer level 17.

notes: Metamagic is a passive option-grant, not an activated ability. Three distinct structural gaps compound: (1) no passive_grant or option_grant class feature family — the activation family's required fields (activationCost, resource, resetCadence) are categorically inapplicable; (2) no cross-feature shared resource pool type — Sorcery Points are defined by Font of Magic and shared across multiple Sorcerer features; (3) no ClassFeatureEffect variant for 'grant access to N menu options with a scaling count'. Individual Metamagic options (Careful Spell, Quickened Spell, Subtle Spell, etc.) are distinct units with their own mechanics and are not assessed here.
